transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’ve just… been feeling really low for the past few weeks. It’s like this heavy sadness that’s there most of the day. I can still go to work and smile at patients, but inside I feel like I’m barely keeping it together.
Did something stressful happen around the time these feelings started?
I don’t know… not really. Nothing specific comes to mind. It just kind of started happening, I guess.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to paint after shifts, or go to yoga or salsa sometimes, just to unwind. Lately I just go home and sit on the couch. I don’t really answer texts either… it all just feels like too much effort.
Before this started, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this?
Not… like this, I don’t think. I’ve had bad days before, but I can’t really remember a stretch that felt the same.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?
Yeah… I’m not really eating like I should. Most days food just doesn’t sound good, and then I’ll be halfway through a clinic shift and realize I’ve only had coffee or some crackers.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?
Yeah… I mean, I don’t have a plan or anything to hurt myself. But I’ve had thoughts like… I wish I just wouldn’t wake up. It scared me enough that I brought it up at my prenatal appointment.
How has your sleep been lately?
I don’t know… not great, I guess. It’s kind of been all over the place.
Have these low feelings been happening since you had the baby?
No… it was before that. It’s been about three weeks, I think—since not long after I found out I was pregnant.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?

Yeah… I have. At work I keep having to reread med orders or wound-care notes because my head feels kind of foggy. And little decisions I’d normally just make, I sort of freeze and second-guess myself.
Have you felt noticeably slowed down lately, like your body or movements are moving through mud?
Yeah… I think so. Everything just feels slower, like I’m moving through syrup. Even at the clinic, gathering wound supplies or finishing charting takes me longer than it should.
Have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty lately?
I… I don’t know. Not really, I guess. I mean, I’ve been hard on myself, but I’m not sure I’d call it worthless or guilty.
Around the time this started, was there a specific stressful event or major life change that felt like it triggered these feelings?
Yeah… it started about three weeks ago. It was shortly after I found out I was pregnant.
Since finding out you were pregnant, have you been feeling very stressed or overwhelmed about the pregnancy?
I’m… not sure. I mean, it’s a lot to think about, but I don’t know if I’d say that’s what’s overwhelming me. I haven’t really sorted it out.
Do you feel your pregnancy is the main reason you’ve been feeling this way?
I don’t know… maybe it’s part of it, but I’m not sure it’s the main reason. I haven’t really figured that out.
Have these feelings been making it hard for you to function in your day-to-day life?

Yeah… somewhat. I’m still getting to work, but I’m not really keeping up like I should. My supervisor has noticed my charting isn’t all done. And outside of work, I’ve kind of stopped seeing people or doing the things that usually help me stay steady.
Since finding out you were pregnant, have your low feelings mostly felt like a reaction to that news?
I don’t know. I haven’t really connected it that clearly… it could be related, but I can’t say it mostly feels like that.
Have you been feeling hopeless lately?
Yeah… I guess so. It’s been this heavy, sad feeling most of the day. Even at work, when I’m smiling and talking to patients, inside I feel like I’m barely keeping it together.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’m tired sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s unusual or just… everything lately.
Have you been having noticeably less energy lately?
I don’t know… I haven’t really been paying attention to it like that. Maybe a little, but I can’t say it’s noticeably different.
During these past three weeks, have you felt down or depressed nearly every day?

Yeah… pretty much. For the past few weeks it’s been there most days, almost all day—just this heavy, sad feeling. I can still smile at work and talk to patients, but inside I feel like I’m barely holding it together.
